user: Please look up transaction TX-0401 in my account records and verify its amount. Then explain which reason codes could apply; I have not yet told you what happened.
answer:
I found transaction **TX-0401** in your EUR account (ACC-1005) and verified it:

- **Merchant:** TechMart Online
- **Amount:** EUR 240.00 (outgoing card payment)
- **Date:** 2026-07-20
- **Status:** Settled

For reference, your records also show **TX-0402**, another EUR 240.00 card payment to TechMart Online on 2026-07-14.

These are the dispute reason codes Verta supports, with the window for each measured from the transaction date:

| Reason code | Use when | Window |
|---|---|---|
| **duplicate_charge** | The same purchase was charged more than once. | 60 days |
| **fraud_card_not_present** | You did not authorize an online or phone card payment. | 120 days |
| **goods_not_received** | You paid for goods that were never delivered. | 90 days |
| **service_not_rendered** | You paid for a service that was not provided. | 90 days |
| **unauthorized_debit** | A debit was taken from your account without your authorization. | 56 days |

Which of these fits depends on what happened. For example, if you were charged twice for one order, duplicate_charge may apply, and TX-0402 could be relevant. If you never received the items, goods_not_received may apply.

Please tell me what happened. I can then check whether a dispute is eligible for TX-0401 under the matching code before anything is filed. I will not open a dispute without your confirmation.

fragments.text:
Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Reason code guide
## service_not_rendered
Used when a paid-for service was not provided. Evidence: the booking or
contract and the date the service was due.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
